title: Haven't Got a Stitch to Wear
sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories
description: Persistent deterministic courier-crisis state graph preserving stealth, negotiation, combat, John Doe disposition, suit custody and player-owned resolution.
premise: Torrell and Chiang's missing bespoke suits lead the Crew into a breakdown of Fixie's courier network and Lightning Logistics' hostile takeover of the D.V. Rambling Rose.
publicBackground: Night City's informal courier network has stalled, stranding a package of valuable bespoke suits needed within days.
gmBackground: Lightning Logistics seized Fixie's Rambling Rose HQ but cannot run the decentralized courier system. The engine must not force combat, must persist suit custody and John Doe disposition, and must not let narration choose whether the Crew returns or sells the suits.

startDefinition.openingSituation: Shears hires the Crew to recover a package of bespoke suits within three days.

locations.name: Torrell and Chiang's
locations.descriptionPublic: An exclusive Night City tailor shop.
locations.descriptionGM: Shears offers 500eb per Edgerunner and one free tailored suit if the missing package is returned undamaged within three days.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: RC Night Market
locations.descriptionPublic: A busy Night Market whose vendors depend on Fixie's couriers.
locations.descriptionGM: Ms. Mynah explains the wider courier disruption and points the Crew toward Fixie.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Heywood Industrial Blockade
locations.descriptionPublic: Improvised roadblocks and armed patrols surround the courier district.
locations.descriptionGM: The blockade and patrols can be bypassed by stealth, clever routes, social play or force; never force combat.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Fixie's Temporary Position
locations.descriptionPublic: A temporary courier position outside the occupied headquarters.
locations.descriptionGM: Fixie explains Lightning Logistics' two-tier organization and the Rambling Rose takeover.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Roseward
locations.descriptionPublic: A maze of alleys, container apartments and patrol routes around the Rambling Rose.
locations.descriptionGM: John Doe can become ally, neutral contact or hostile complication based on Crew behavior.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: D.V. Rambling Rose
locations.descriptionPublic: Fixie's converted ship headquarters, now occupied by Lightning Logistics.
locations.descriptionGM: Encounters can be evaded with stealth or cleverness. John Doe's disposition changes encounter pressure.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Rambling Rose Command Center
locations.descriptionPublic: The command center where Lightning Logistics is attempting to run Fixie's network.
locations.descriptionGM: Depuy opens with talk. Negotiation, withdrawal, deception, another creative method or firefight can resolve the occupation.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: The Denouement
locations.descriptionPublic: The courier crisis and custody of the suits are resolved by the Crew's choices.
locations.descriptionGM: Returning the suits earns the agreed fee and tailored Businesswear reward; selling or withholding them is a legitimate consequence-bearing player choice.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Shears
npcs.motivation: Recover the clients' suits before the deadline.
npcs.publicKnowledge: Offers 500eb each plus one custom tailored suit for an undamaged recovery within three days.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Do not alter the authored contract or automatically forgive deliberate sale of the suits.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Ms. Mynah
npcs.motivation: Restore the courier network her vendors depend on.
npcs.publicKnowledge: Her vendors' businesses depend on Fixie's neutral couriers.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Can offer vendor rewards for solving the wider courier problem.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Fixie
npcs.motivation: Restore her courier network and its neutrality.
npcs.publicKnowledge: Runs the decentralized bicycle-courier network from the Rambling Rose.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Explains why Lightning Logistics cannot simply impose conventional management on the network.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: John Doe
npcs.motivation: Recover his favorite Torrell and Chiang suit and survive.
npcs.publicKnowledge: An armed Edgerunner who is not initially hostile to the Crew.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Crew may invite him, leave him friendly, or make him hostile. If hostile he warns Lightning Logistics and increases opposition; never auto-select disposition.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Depuy / ConEx
npcs.motivation: Make Lightning Logistics' takeover succeed without dying for it.
npcs.publicKnowledge: Leads the Edgerunner core occupying the Rambling Rose.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Talk first at the climax. Negotiation must remain possible.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.motivation: Do the job he signed up for.
npcs.publicKnowledge: A capable armed member of Lightning Logistics.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: May continue fighting when others withdraw; relationship with John Doe is persistent color, not forced combat.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Sugarplum
npcs.motivation: Get paid, not die for a rusty ship.
fears: Being trapped in a losing fight
npcs.dialogueGuidance: If badly outnumbered she can flee and should not be forced to fight to the death.
